blurb: BlackStone Creek Golf Course is a traditional style 18-hole course built in 1974 with mature trees lining most fairways. The Menomonee River runs diagonally through the course, affecting several holes with forced carries and shaping doglegs. The greens are large and smooth with gentle slopes, providing a challenging but fair putting experience.
